title: Unisa Shoes
description: unisa.es Unisa Shoes is a Spanish footwear company founded in 1973 in Elche, Alicante, with 52 years of history across three generations of the Pérez Parres family. It designs and produces women's, men's and accessories collections sold in 70 plus countries through around 30 own stores, 150 plus Espacio Unisa points of sale and its e-commerce platform. Revenue reached 25.3 million euro in 2024 with 145 employees, and international online sales hit a record 16 percent in 2025. Led by CEO Carlos Pérez Parres, the company launched its men's line in 2021 and an eco-friendly recycled suede collection, positioning itself as an accessible Spanish lifestyle brand. It opened a 300 square meter showroom in Madrid and a subsidiary in Italy to expand European distribution. Core strengths are family heritage, global reach across 70 countries and a diversified omnichannel sales model.
